sequence. Pure host tests (protocore_cycles() falls back to a coarse host stand-in; only ordering,
not magnitude, is asserted for assembly_cycles).

native_tsan.desc:
Same harness under ThreadSanitizer: proves ZERO data races on the slot fields
(the protocore_atomic acquire/release happens-before lets the plain rx_buffer[] writes
be read on the other core safely). TSan ships with clang/gcc on Linux, so this
env is run by the test CI (ubuntu); it is not buildable on the Windows host.

native_ubx_codec.desc: u-blox UBX binary protocol codec (services/timing_position/ubx): B5 62 framing, the 8-bit Fletcher checksum over the class..payload span, build / poll / parse, the CFG-MSG and CFG-RATE commands, the NAV-PVT / NAV-TIMEUTC / NAV-SAT decoders against the published u-blox field offsets, and the streaming NMEA+UBX demultiplexer. KATs are the published poll frames UBX-MON-VER (B5 62 0A 04 00 00 0E 34) and UBX-CFG-PRT (B5 62 06 00 00 00 06 18) plus the published 1 Hz CFG-RATE and NAV-PVT CFG-MSG commands, each checksum re-derived from the Fletcher definition. Pure host tests.

native_udp.desc:
The UDP path a stack drives, run on the host against the pcb driver in core_setup/hal/host. Covers udp_listener + udp_client against the
host pcb driver: the receive ring, both send paths reaching the wire in the call that makes them,
NetAddr carrying v4 and v6 both ways, the pbuf pool refusing, and the datagrams the core handed to the stack read back as a DLT_RAW libpcap
capture with synthesized IP and UDP headers (core_setup/hal/host/protocore_net_pcap.h).

native_udp_telemetry.desc:
UDP telemetry line builder (services/iot/udp_telemetry): InfluxDB line-protocol
formatting, host-tested. The UDP cast is ESP32-only (#ifdef ARDUINO).

native_udp_transport.desc:
UDP transport multicast receive (network_drivers/transport/udp.c): joining an IPv4
multicast group by dotted-quad, rejecting a non-multicast or malformed group, delivering a group
datagram to the registered handler, and leaving the group (releasing the listener slot). Drives the
host UDP mock's inject seam.

native_umati.desc:
umati / OPC UA for Machine Tools (OPC 40501-1) MachineTool model (services/machine_tool/umati) - the
Browse hierarchy + the Read resolver over a bound UmatiMachineTool are host-tested here.
Requires the OPC UA codec. No heap, no stdlib.

native_upload.desc:
Streaming file upload: POST body -> FS file via the parser streaming hook.
Small BODY_BUF_SIZE exercises multi-chunk streaming; the mock FS captures the
written bytes (core_setup/hal/host/FS.h write-capture).

native_utf8.desc:
UTF-8 well-formedness (shared/utf8): the RFC 3629 sec 3 shortest-form boundaries, and the
sec 10 refusals a lax decoder gets wrong - overlong encodings (C0 AF), surrogates
U+D800..U+DFFF, code points above U+10FFFF, and truncated sequences. Pure host tests.

native_utmc_xml.desc: UTMC common-database codec (services/transportation/utmc): the UTMCRequest and UTMCResponse documents, the quality flag, and the request-id parse. The escaping is anchored on XML 1.0 sec 4.6 (the five predefined entities) and sec 2.4 (& and < always, " inside a double-quoted attribute, ' need not be), so a detector id carrying an ampersand cannot produce a document no parser will accept. Plus the overflow-is-refused-whole boundary. Pure host tests.

native_vl53l0x.desc: VL53L0X time-of-flight ranging (server/peripherals/vl53l0x): the 16-bit distance from RESULT_RANGE_STATUS + 10 high octet first, the data-ready bits of RESULT_INTERRUPT_STATUS, the DeviceRangeStatus field in bits 6:3 where only 11 (RANGECOMPLETE) is a good ranging, and driving a part end to end - the suite puts a distance in front of the device model in core_setup/hal/host/devices/, which serves one measurement per interrupt so a driver that never clears it is caught.

native_vxi11.desc:
VXI-11 (TCP/IP Instrument Protocol) codec over ONC RPC / XDR (services/instrumentation/vxi11): the XDR
write/read helpers (4-byte-aligned, big-endian, length-prefixed opaque/string), the ONC-RPC
record-marking + CALL/REPLY framing with AUTH_NONE, the portmapper GETPORT call, and the
DEVICE_CORE procedures (create_link / device_write / device_read / device_readstb /
destroy_link). Pure host tests with byte-exact vectors.

native_wal.desc:
Write-ahead store for atomic buffer-to-flash storage (services/storage/wal): CRC32 record
framing + crash-recovery replay (the atomicity core), plus the A/B superblock + checkpoint + mount
layer over a block-device seam. Pure host tests, incl. the CRC-32 check vector, torn/truncated-tail
recovery to the last good record, checkpoint durability, and superblock fallback.

native_wamp.desc:
WAMP messaging codec (services/iot/wamp): the JSON-array message builders (HELLO /
SUBSCRIBE / PUBLISH / CALL / REGISTER / YIELD / GOODBYE over JsonWriter) + the positional
array parser (type / ids / URIs, nesting-aware). Pure host tests.

native_wave_wsmp.desc: IEEE 1609 WAVE codec (services/transportation/wave): the PSID P-encoding at both ends of all four length classes, the 1609.3 WSMP header build and parse, and the 1609.2 secured-message envelope. IEEE 1609 is not obtainable, so the vectors are derived from the documented P-encoding rule with the derivation written beside them; the load-bearing case is the round-trip property that every PSID the encoder accepts must decode back to itself. Pure host tests.

native_wearlevel.desc:
Flash wear-leveling slot selector (server/storage/wearlevel): least-worn pick (ties -> lowest
index), saturating mark, and the wear-imbalance spread metric. Pure host tests - a 4000-write
pick+mark loop must level every slot exactly.

native_webdav_wire.desc: WebDAV wire core (network_drivers/application/webdav, RFC 4918). Walks every cell of the sec 9.10.5 Lock Compatibility Table, the sec 9.10.3 Depth-infinity lock scope and its path-segment boundary, the sec 6.6 timeout sweep and sec 9.10.2 refresh, the sec 7 write gate keyed on the If-header token, the sec 10.4.2 If ABNF with the worked examples of secs 10.4.6 and 10.4.7, the sec 10.2 Depth ABNF, the sec 9 method set, the sec 14.16 Multi-Status document and the sec 9.2 PROPPATCH 403 reflection, plus the five XML 1.0 sec 4.6 predefined entities and the RFC 3986 sec 2.1 percent-decoding of the Destination header.

native_webdav_handler.desc: WebDAV request handler over a directory-capable FS mock (recursive COPY/MOVE/DELETE)

native_webhook_json.desc: Outbound webhook builders (services/net/webhook/webhook.c): the RFC 8259 section 4 object grammar and the section 7 escaping of the quotation mark and reverse solidus in the value1/value2/value3 content, the RFC 3986 section 3.3 path segment order of the IFTTT Maker target URI, and the fail-closed behavior of both builders. The POST reports a transport error on a build with no HTTP client under it.

native_radio_wifi_sniffer.desc:
802.11 sniffer core (services/radio/wifi_sniffer). The MAC header decode is anchored on IEEE Std
802.11 sec 9.2.4.1's Frame Control layout (Protocol Version B0-B1, Type B2-B3, Subtype B4-B7, To DS
B8, From DS B9, Retry B11, Protected Frame B14, least significant octet first) and Table 9-1's
Type/Subtype assignment, exercised on a beacon header built field by field. Also the truncated
capture address count, the per-type tally, the RSSI hysteresis roam decision at and either side of
its threshold, the channel-hop dwell schedule with its clamping and millis-rollover safety, and the
per-channel RSSI survey with its strongest-other-channel candidate.

native_wifi_sniffer_promisc.desc: The wifi_sniffer's live binding, the arm PROTOCORE_ENABLE_PROMISC compiles: begin drives services/radio/promisc into monitor mode and the channel-hop dwell moves it. The codec env builds the other arm, where there is no capture source and the sniff does not start.

native_radio_wisun.desc:
Wi-SUN FAN border-router connector (services/radio/wisun). The CoAP client request builder is
anchored on RFC 7252: Appendix A Figure 16's Confirmable GET for /temperature (MID 0x7d34, 16
octets) reproduced octet for octet, sec 3's header packing and 0xFF payload marker, sec 3.1's
option (delta, length) nibble header with its 13-extension, and sec 5.10.1's one Uri-Path option
per path segment. Also the FAN node registry (register, refresh, find, joined count, full table)
over protocore_ip and the RFC 5952 canonical addresses its JSON emits.

native_workers.desc:
Core-partitioning invariant at N=2 (PROTOCORE_WORKER_COUNT=2): each worker reaps
only its owned slots (check_timeouts ownership). The host queue is keyed by handle, so
per-worker routing is checkable here rather than only on hardware.

native_workers_stack.desc:
PROTOCORE_WORKER_COUNT=2 over the stack path, which nothing else compiles: native_tcp is
single-worker and takes the other arm of listener_enqueue, so the multi-worker arm - the per-worker queue routing and the wake that
follows it - had no witness in the matrix at all.

native_ws_client_rfc6455.desc: WebSocket client codec (services/net/ws_client/ws_client.c) against RFC 6455: the section 1.3 and 4.2.2 |Sec-WebSocket-Accept| worked example, the section 4.1 opening handshake field lines and the 101 response check, and the section 5.2 base framing protocol with the section 5.3 masking transformation - checked against the frames section 5.7 prints, including the 256-octet and 64 KiB extended payload lengths. Codec only - this build has no transport.

native_ws_client_session.desc: WebSocket client with a net stack: the connection arm and its three rings, which the codec env compiles away

native_ws_deflate.desc:
WebSocket permessage-deflate (RFC 7692) inbound path wired through the real WS
stack: handshake negotiation, the RSV1 frame path, and INFLATE delivery (with
the table scratch borrowed from the shared arena). Runs test_websocket with the
feature on (the deflate cases are #if-gated).

native_xmpp.desc:
XMPP stanza codec (services/iot/xmpp, RFC 6120): XML-escaped stream/message/presence/iq
builders and the stanza-name + attribute readers. Pure host tests with exact-output vectors.

native_radio_zigbee.desc:
Zigbee EZSP / ASH data-link framing codec (services/radio/zigbee). The CRC is pinned to the
CRC-16/IBM-3740 catalogue check value 0x29B1, and the RST frame Silicon Labs UG101 prints
(C0 38 BC 7E) is reproduced with its CRC half derived step by step from the polynomial definition.
Also the six reserved octets and their 0x7D (octet XOR 0x20) escapes, the CRC's coverage of control
then payload most significant octet first, encode/decode round trips, single-bit corruption,
dangling escapes, short frames, stream framing, and the bounds refusals.

native_radio_zwave.desc:
Z-Wave Serial API frame codec (services/radio/zwave). Anchored on the Silicon Labs Serial API
(INS12350) data frame SOF | LEN | Type | Command | Data | Checksum: the FUNC_ID_ZW_GET_VERSION
request 01 03 00 15 E9 with its checksum octet derived from the 0xFF XOR fold, LEN's span over Type
through Checksum, the checksum's span over LEN through the last data octet, a build/parse round
trip, single-bit corruption, a non-SOF start, partial arrival, out-of-range LEN, the ACK/NAK/CAN
control octets, and the build bounds.
